</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Under consideration</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Aura Filtering Improvements}}
:We are looking at ways to improve aura filtering.
;{{text|blizz|Mythic+ Trash Count APIs}}
:We are considering adding APIs to allow addons to be able to keep track of trash counts in M+.
</details>

==December 1: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1445127028113145970 Midnight Beta 3 (updated 4real) Changes]==

Blizzard again! Below you will find a list of changes we are making to addon restriction APIs in the coming weeks. 

These are not the entirety of the changes we are planning, just the ones already committed to for the next few Beta releases.

''Editor's note: Lines with an 🆙 mark were moved up from a lower section (or updated) from last week's post. Lines marked with 🆕 are new to this week's post.''

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Coming in Beta 3 (ETA 12/3)</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Smooth Status Bars}}
:We have added native support for status bars to smoothly transition between values.
:Usage: {{api|StatusBar:SetValue(value, Enum.StatusBarInterpolation.ExponentialEaseOut)}} ({{api|StatusBar:SetMinMaxValues|SetMinMaxValue}} also has the extra optional parameter)
:The {{api|StatusBar:SetFillStyle|SetFillStyle}} method on StatusBar has been updated to take a StatusBarFillStyle enum value rather than a string like "REVERSE".
;{{text|blizz|Unit Power}} 🆙
:We have relaxed restrictions around {{api|UnitPower}} so the player's [[Resource|secondary resources]] are no longer secret (primary resources remain secret). Affected resources: [[Combo Points]], [[Runes]], [[:Soul Shards]], [[Holy Power]], [[Chi]], [[Arcane Charge]]s, [[Essence]].
:The [[:Maelstrom Weapon]] '''and [[:Ebon Might]]''' auras will be flagged as non-secret in an upcoming build.
:The {{api|UnitStagger}} API no longer returns secrets when called for the player.
:{{api|UnitPowerMax}} will now return a non-secret 0 value if the unit doesn't use the power type passed in.
;{{text|blizz|Cooldowns}} 🆕
:Similar to our recent changes for spellcasts and auras, we have added a way for us to flag a particular spell's cooldown as non-secret. We will be flagging various spells with this flag in the coming weeks.
;{{text|blizz|Auras}} 🆕
:Added a new API {{api|C_StringUtil.TruncateWhenZero(number)}} which returns the number as a secret string if the value is > 0, and returns an empty string if the value is 0.
:Added a new API {{api|C_StringUtil.WrapString(infix[, prefix[, suffix]])}}, which returns the concatenation of prefix .. infix .. suffix if infix isn't an empty string. If it is, then the return is an empty string.
:Added a new Cooldown API {{api|Cooldown:SetCooldownFromExpirationTime(expirationTime, duration[, modRate])|SetCooldownFromExpirationTime}}.
;{{text|blizz|Boolean Secrets}} 🆕
:Added a new Frame and Region API {{api|Region:SetAlphaFromBoolean(bool[, alphaIfTrue[, alphaIfFalse]])|SetAlphaFromBoolean}} to adjust the alpha of regions from secret boolean values.
;{{text|blizz|Unit Identity}} 🆕
:We have relaxed restrictions on the {{api|UnitIsUnit}} API to allow it to return a non-secret value when comparing units with the following unit tokens: target, focus, mouseover, softenemy, softinteract, softfriend.
:The result of UnitIsUnit will remain secret if the other unit token being compared against is a compound token (e.g. boss1target, raid13targettarget).
;{{text|blizz|Secret Testing}} 🆙
:We have added several cvars that allow addon authors to replicate various restricted states for testing purposes (none of them save between sessions):
::{{apitooltip|type=cvar|name=addonChatRestrictionsForced|default=0|cat=4|desc=If true, force the client into the chat lockdown state. This is provided for addon author testing and will not persist across client restarts.}}, secretAurasForced, secretCooldownsForced, secretUnitIdentityForced, secretSpellcastsForced, secretUnitPowerForced, secretUnitPowerMaxForced, secretUnitComparisonForced.
::None of these CVars will persist across client restarts.
:We will be adding a test encounter and several test units (who spam various kinds of spells) inside the [[MOTHERLODE!!]] dungeon to allow addons devs to test boss warnings and enemy nameplates/unit frames in an encounter setting (without having to run real dungeons over and over).
:The test encounter will be located on the beach to the right of the entrance.
;{{text|blizz|Tooltips}} 🆕
:We have fixed several secret-related tooltip Lua errors, including those triggered by registering tooltip data/line processor callbacks.
:If you are still seeing issues with secrets in tooltips please report them in the ⁠addon-restrictions-feedback channel.
;{{text|blizz|FontString Measurement}}
:The {{api|FontString:CalculateScreenAreaFromCharacterSpan|CalculateScreenAreaFromCharacterSpan}} and {{api|FontString:FindCharacterIndexAtCoordinate|FindCharacterIndexAtCoordinate}} APIs have had additional protections added to them to prevent addons from using them on fontstrings with the text secret aspect applied to them.
:[[XML/ScrollingMessageFrame|ScrollingMessageFrame]] has had further protection added to prevent the above exploits.
;{{text|blizz|Exploit Fixes}}
:Fixed an exploit that allowed addons to call arbitrary functions with creative use of [[SecureActionButtonTemplate]].
:Removed {{api|secretunwrap}} from the global table.
:{{api|t=e|UNIT_SPELLCAST_SENT}} now sends the target name parameter as a secret.
;{{text|blizz|Misc Changes}} 🆙
:{{api|Region:SetAlpha|SetAlpha}} now always clamps its value to the range [0, 1] without raising an error.
:Fixed an issue where opening a unit frame menu while in combat would cause secret-related Lua errors.
:Fixed an issue where calling SetToDefaults on a region with the shown secret aspect would cause an assert.
:Fixed an issue where receiving a whisper while in chat messaging lockdown would result in Lua error spam originating in the UIFrameFlash_OnUpdate function.
:Added a new {{api|t=e|LEGACY_LOOT_RULES_CHANGED}} event.
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Currently being worked on</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Action Buttons}}
:We are making various improvements to action button APIs to address issues raised in the ⁠addon-restrictions-feedback channel.
;{{text|blizz|Auras}}
:We are making various improvements to Aura APIs to address issues raised in the ⁠addon-restrictions-feedback channel.
;{{text|blizz|Boolean secrets}}
:We are addressing various pain-points with Boolean secrets (by adding APIs that accept them in safe ways).
;{{text|blizz|Aura Sorting}} 🆙
:We will be adding support for sorting auras by remaining duration.
;{{text|blizz|Timer Status Bars}} 🆙
:We will be adding support for timer status bars that automatically update on their own based on the current time.
;{{text|blizz|Raid Target API}} 🆙
:SetRaidTarget will be made usable via [[SecureActionButtonTemplate]]
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Coming soon</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Mouse-Less UI Accessibility}}
:We will be addressing pain points faced by gamepad and accessibility addons around emulating mouse interactions with arbitrary frames (exact details are yet to be decided).
;{{text|blizz|More Curves!}}
:We will be adding more usages of the curve tech we added back in Alpha 4. Candidates under consideration for curve treatment include: Important Spellcasts, Interruptible Spellcasts, Aura Dispel Types, Stealable Auras. If you have other candidates you would like considered please provide them in the feedback channel
;{{text|blizz|Unit Death}}
:We will be adding an event that gets sent down when a unit dies. The GUID payload will be secret in the same cases cooldowns & auras are secret.
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Under consideration</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Aura Filtering Improvements}}
:We are looking at ways to improve aura filtering.
;{{text|blizz|Mythic+ Trash Count APIs}}
:We are considering adding APIs to allow addons to be able to keep track of trash counts in M+.
</details>

==December 8: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1447679804961853531 Midnight Beta 4 Changes]==
Blizzard again! Below you will find a list of changes we are making to addon restriction APIs in the coming weeks. 

These are not the entirety of the changes we are planning, just the ones already committed to for the next few Beta releases.

IMPORTANT: You may notice that the Beta build this week has switched to a 12.0.1 version number instead of 12.0.0. This is because 12.0.0 will be the version used for Midnight pre-patch, and 12.0.1 will be the version used for actual Midnight launch.

The remainder of Beta will feature 12.0.1 builds, while PTR (when it goes up) will feature 12.0.0 builds. We will continue to make addon-related changes in 12.0.0 until we make our pre-patch Release Candidate (RC) build. One important thing to note here is that we DO plan to have these new addon restrictions active in pre-patch (12.0.0), rather than waiting until 12.0.1.

The reason for this is we want to give players a chance to get used to the new addon landscape prior to Midnight launch. We are not in 12.0.0 RC yet, so you can continue to test in Beta for now, but once we pick an RC build (we will let you know when that happens) we advise addon authors looking to prepare for pre-patch switch to testing on PTR instead of Beta.

After the 12.0.0 RC is chosen, our engineers will be switching over to making most addon-related changes in 12.0.1 (outside of very high priority stuff). We will continue to make changes to 12.0.1 all the way up until launch (and well past launch even, in follow-up patches) to provide you with more of the QoL changes you have requested.

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Coming in Beta 4 (ETA 12/9)</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Action Buttons & Cooldowns}}
:Added a new ActionButton_ApplyCooldown global function (which uses a secure delegate) to allow addons to create action button cooldown frames by passing in 3 tables containing secret cooldown values.
::ActionButtonTemplate's cooldown frame has been split into 3 separate frames (cooldown, chargeCooldown, and lossOfControlCooldown) for use in this function.
:Added 2 new APIs {{api|C_ActionBar.GetActionDisplayCount}} and {{api|C_Spell.GetSpellDisplayCount}}, for displaying counts on action buttons.
:{{api|C_Spell.IsConsumableSpell|IsConsumableSpell}} has been moved into the C_Spell namespace.
;{{text|blizz|Addon Restriction States}}
:Added a new C_Secrets namespace, containing a host of functions for addons to use to test whether various APIs will return secrets based off particular inputs ({{api|C_Secrets.ShouldUnitSpellCastBeSecret|ShouldUnitSpellCastBeSecret}}, {{api|C_Secrets.ShouldUnitComparisonBeSecret|ShouldUnitComparisonBeSecret}}, etc).
:Added a new [[Enum.AddOnRestrictionType|AddOnRestrictionType enum]] that contains the various different scenarios in which we apply secret restrictions (Combat, Encounter, ChallengeMode, PvPMatch and Map)
:Added a new [[Enum.AddOnRestrictionState|AddOnRestrictionState enum]] that is used to specify what state each AddOnRestrictionType is currently in (Inactive, Activating or Active)
:Added a new C_RestrictedActions namespace, which contains APIs for testing whether an AddOnRestrictionType is currently active, as well as a new event that gets sent down to Lua when a AddOnRestrictionType's state changes.
::The timing of these events is similar to {{api|t=e|PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED}} and {{api|t=e|PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED}} - they will always fire the immediate moment before a restriction activates, or after it deactivates.
;{{text|blizz|Timer Status Bars}}
:Added a new API SetTimer to StatusBar frames for creating timer status bars, which can be used to create self-updating timer bars.
:Added a set of related APIs to StatusBar for querying the state of timer status bars (GetDuration, GetStartTime, GetEndTime, GetElapsedTime and GetRemainingTime).
;{{text|blizz|Auras}}
:Added new sortRule and sortDirection parameters to {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetUnitAuras}}.
::Current SortRule options are Unsorted, Default, BigDefensive, Expiration, ExpirationOnly, Name, and NameOnly (all of which have descriptions in the docs).
::SortDirection can be either Normal or Reverse.
:Added a new API {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetUnitAuraInstanceIDs}}, which takes the same parameters as C_UnitAuras.GetUnitAuras but just returns a vector of auraInstanceIDs instead of full AuraData.
:Added a new API {{api|C_UnitAuras.DoesAuraHaveExpirationTime}}.
:Added a new API {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetAuraApplicationDisplayCount}} that returns the application count of an aura formatted as a string, with a configurable minimum bound below which an empty string will be returned.
:Added a new API {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDispelTypeColor}} that evaluates a dispel type ID through a [[ScriptObject ColorCurveObject|color curve]].
:<s>Added a new API {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDurationRemainingPercent}} that returns the remaining duration of an aura (with the start point calculated as expiration - duration) as a percentage, optionally re-scalable by a [[ScriptObject CurveObject|curve]].</s>
:<s>Added a new API {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDurationRemainingColor}} that's the same as the above, but evaluates a non-optional color curve for the result instead.</s>
:<s>Added the following APIs to C_ActionBar, which work just like the UnitAuras APIs above: {{api|C_ActionBar.GetActionCooldownRemaining|GetActionCooldownRemaining}}, {{api|C_ActionBar.GetActionCooldownRemainingPercent|GetActionCooldownRemainingPercent}}, and {{api|C_ActionBar.GetActionCooldownRemainingColor|GetActionCooldownRemainingColor}}.</s>
:<s>Added the following APIs to C_Spell, which work just like the UnitAuras APIs above: {{api|C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownRemaining|GetSpellCooldownRemaining}}, {{api|C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownRemainingPercent|GetSpellCooldownRemainingPercent}}, and {{api|C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownRemainingColor|GetSpellCooldownRemainingColor}}.</s>
::'''Note''': In a future build, the Color APIs listed above (with the exception of GetAuraDispelTypeColor) will be merged into the Percent APIs.
::The Percent functions will accept any curve type and return the evaluated result - so passing a color curve into GetSpellCooldownRemainingPercent will return a ColorMixin.
;{{text|blizz|More Curves!}}
:Added a new CurveConstants.lua file, which some pre-defined curves: ScaleTo100, Reverse, and ReverseTo100.
:{{api|UnitHealthPercent}} and {{api|UnitPowerPercent}} now take an optional curve instead of a boolean scaleTo100 parameter.
;{{text|blizz|Boolean Secrets}}
:Added a new SetVertexColorFromBoolean API to FontString and Texture types.
;{{text|blizz|Misc Changes}}
:The {{api|C_Housing.VisitHouse|VisitHouse}}, {{api|C_Housing.TeleportHome|TeleportHome}} and {{api|C_Housing.ReturnAfterVisitingHouse|ReturnAfterVisitingHouse}} APIs in C_Housing are no longer allowed to be called by addons. Added new secure action delegates for all three.
:Added a new raidTarget secure action delegate to allow addons to set, clear or toggle raid targets on units.
;{{text|blizz|Bug fixes}}
:Fixed an issue where addons using metatables in the restricted environment would cause lua errors.
;{{text|blizz|Exploit fixes}}
:The {{api|CheckButton SetChecked}} API no longer accepts secrets from tainted code.
:Fixed an exploit involving using a particular API to create a nasty wormhole into the restricted environment. Also hardened up the code against similar exploits.
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Currently being worked on</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Mouse-Less UI Accessibility}}
:We are addressing pain points faced by gamepad and accessibility addons around emulating mouse interactions with arbitrary frames.
;{{text|blizz|More Tooltip Fixes}}
:We are creating secure delegates for all of the Set* GameTooltip APIs so addons can safely use them without taint issues.
;{{text|blizz|Addon Menus In Restricted Areas}}
:We are working on a solution to prevent addon-created menus from throwing a bunch of lua errors when secret restrictions are in place (e.g. in dungeons).
;{{text|blizz|Channeled and Empowered Casts}}
:We are changing the restrictions on channeled and empowered casts to match those for normal {{api|t=e|UNIT_SPELLCAST}} casts (non-secret for the player's own casts).
:This includes APIs for calculating empower stages on cast bars.
;{{text|blizz|UnitFrame Heal Absorb & Heal Prediction}}
:We are addressing issues addons are having showing heal absorbs & prediction in custom unit frames.
;{{text|blizz|Damage Meter Improvements}}
:We are making various improvements to the Damage Meter APIs to allow addons to be able to access certain information as non-secrets.
;{{text|blizz|Secrets in Event Trace}}
:We are making some improvements to allow secret state to be shown in Event Trace logs.
;{{text|blizz|Combo Point APIs}}
:We are loosening restrictions on the {{api|GetComboPoints}} and {{api|GetUnitChargedPowerPoints}} APIs to use the same rules as combo points do in {{api|UnitPower}}.
;{{text|blizz|More Curves!}}
:We are continuing to add more usages of the curves tech. If you have other candidates you would like us to consider please provide them in the feedback channel.
;{{text|blizz|Chat Addon QoL Changes}}
:We are adding various QoL changes for chat addons, including making some chat events no longer secret in chat lockdown, and providing more string APIs that accept secrets
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Coming soon</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Aura Instance ID Exploits}}
:We are aware of some exploits involving comparing aura instance IDs to each other as a way to identify units and facilitate communication between addons. We will be locking these exploits down before 12.0.1.
;{{text|blizz|Addon Communication Workarounds}}
:Thanks for identifying numerous communication workarounds in the ⁠addon-restrictions-feedback channel. We will be locking down all of the APIs mentioned very soon, keep those examples coming as you find them!
;{{text|blizz|Nameplate HitRect APIs}}
:We will be adding an API to allow addons to override the offsets of nameplate hit-rects (now that those are no longer directly accessible by addons).
</details>

===December 10: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1448829840420765929 Midnight Beta 3.0+1.0 Thrice Upon a Time Changes]===
Blizzard again! Sorry for the delay on Beta 4, we ended up having to make a whole new build due to some issues in the previous build. The silver lining however is that because a new build was needed, some more addon changes we able to sneak into Beta 4! Listed below are just the new things.

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Late Beta 4 additions</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Mouse-Less UI Accessibility}}
:We have added several new APIs specifically for use by gamepad-related addons. All of these are only available when outside combat and in response to a gamepad hardware event.
:{{api|SetCursorPosition(x,y)}} allows addons to set the position of the mouse cursor.
:{{api|SimulateMouseDown}}, {{api|SimulateMouseUp}}, and {{api|SimulateMouseClick}} take a button object as a parameter and allows addons to simulate mouse click events on them.
:{{api|SimulateMouseWheel}} takes a delta and allows addons to simulate the player moving their mouse wheel up or down.
;{{text|blizz|Addon Menus In Restricted Areas}}
:We have fixed the issues causing addon-created menus to throw a bunch of lua errors when secret restrictions are in place (e.g. in dungeons).
;{{text|blizz|Tooltip Fixes}}
:We have converted all of the Set* [[UIOBJECT GameTooltip|GameTooltip]] APIs to secure delegates so addons can safely use them without taint issues.
;{{text|blizz|Secrets in Event Trace}}
:[[MACRO eventtrace|Event Trace]] now shows the secret state of event payloads in its logs.
;{{text|blizz|Combo Point APIs}}
:{{api|GetComboPoints}} and {{api|GetUnitChargedPowerPoints}} APIs now return non-secrets.
;{{text|blizz|Channeled and Empowered Casts}}
:Channeled and empowered casts are no longer secret for the player's own casts.
;{{text|blizz|Chat Addon QoL Changes}}
:We have declassified a number of chat message events (for things like {{api|t=e|GUILD_ITEM_LOOTED}}, which are not exploit risks).
:We have added an API {{api|C_StringUtil.RemoveContiguousSpaces|RemoveContiguousSpaces}} that can be used to remove consecutive space characters out of secret strings.
:We have added an API {{api|C_StringUtil.EscapeLuaPatterns|EscapeLuaPatterns}} that can be used escape all Lua pattern characters.
:We have added various global [[EventRegistry]] callbacks to [[ChatFrame]] & ChatFrameEditBox to allow addons to hook them more easily.
;{{text|blizz|Damage Meter Improvements}}
:We have made several fields in Damage Meter APIs non-secret (classFilename, specIconID, isLocalPlayer, unitClassFilename and classification).
:The name field in DamageMeterCombatSource is now only secret for units whose identities are secret.
;{{text|blizz|Duration Objects}}
:Added a new [[ScriptObject DurationObject|first-class Lua-exposed duration object]] type.
:Duration objects can be created via {{api|C_DurationUtil.CreateDuration()}}. This creates an empty (zero) duration.
:The measured duration can be changed by calling {{api|DurationObject SetTimeSpan(start, end)|:SetTimeSpan}}, {{api|DurationObject SetTimeFromStart(startTime, duration[, modRate])|:SetTimeFromStart}} or {{api|DurationObject SetTimeFromEnd(endTime, duration[, modRate])|:SetTimeFromEnd}}.
::These three APIs do not accept secret values from tainted callers.
:Duration objects provide methods such as {{api|DurationObject GetElapsedDuration|GetElapsedDuration}}, {{api|DurationObject GetRemainingDuration|GetRemainingDuration}}, {{api|DurationObject EvalulateElapsedProgress|EvaluateElapsedProgress}}, etc. to perform calculations natively on potentially secret data and return secret results back to Lua.
:Added {{api|Cooldown:SetCooldownFromDurationObject(duration[, clearIfZero])}} that configures a cooldown frame from a duration object.
:Added {{api|StatusBar:SetTimerDuration(duration[, interpolation])}} that configures a statusbar to render from a duration object.
::An extra parameter will be added in a future build to control whether elapsed or remaining time is used for rendering (currently, it's elapsed).
:Added {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetUnitAuraDuration(unitToken, auraInstanceID)}} that returns a duration object representing the queried aura.
:Added C_ActionBar APIs for regular and loss of control cooldowns (and charges) that return duration objects.
:Added C_Spell APIs for regular and loss of control cooldowns (and charges) that return duration objects.
:Added C_SpellBook APIs for regular and loss of control cooldowns (and charges) that return duration objects.
:Added {{api|UnitCastingDuration}} and {{api|UnitChannelDuration}} APIs that return duration objects.
;{{text|blizz|Unit Death}}
:Rumors of the demise of the previously-promised {{api|t=e|UNIT_DEATH}} turn out to have been greatly exaggerated. It too managed to sneak into Beta 4 at the last second. The payload for this event is the GUID of the unit that died, which is secret when that unit's identity is secret.
</details>

==December 16: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1450545379966980319 Midnight Beta 5 Royal Changes]==
Blizzard again! Below you will find a list of changes we are making to addon restriction APIs in the coming weeks.
These are not the entirety of the changes we are planning, just the ones already committed to for the immediately upcoming Beta releases.

NOTE: Beta 5 will be the last Beta build we put out this year. We will be continuing to work on addon dev requests until the holidays but Beta 6 won't be made until January. 
Also note that Beta 4 had more changes than expected, and Beta 5 has fewer due to build timing (Beta 4 ended up being built later than expected).

REMINDER: Beta builds have switched to a 12.0.1 version number instead of 12.0.0. This is because 12.0.0 will be the version used for Midnight pre-patch, and 12.0.1 will be the version used for actual Midnight launch. The remainder of Beta will feature 12.0.1 builds, while PTR (when it goes up) will feature 12.0.0 builds. We will continue to make addon-related changes in 12.0.0 until we make our pre-patch Release Candidate (RC) build.

One important thing to note here is that we DO plan to have these new addon restrictions active in pre-patch (12.0.0), rather than waiting until 12.0.1. The reason for this is we want to give players a chance to get used to the new addon landscape prior to Midnight launch. We are not in 12.0.0 RC yet, so you can continue to test in Beta for now, but once we pick an RC build (we will let you know when that happens) we advise addon authors looking to prepare for pre-patch switch to testing on PTR instead of Beta.

After the 12.0.0 RC is chosen, our engineers will be switching over to making most addon-related changes in 12.0.1 (outside of very high priority stuff). We will continue to make changes to 12.0.1 all the way up until launch (and well past launch even, in follow-up patches) to provide you with more of the QoL changes you have requested.

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Coming in Beta 5 (ETA 12/17)</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|UnitFrame Heal Absorb & Heal Prediction}}
:We have added a new [[ScriptObject UnitHealPredictionCalculator|UnitHealPredictionCalculator]] Lua object (created via a new {{api|CreateUnitHealPredictionCalculator}} API), and an associated API {{api|UnitGetDetailedHealPrediction}} that accepts this object type.
::Addons can use these APIs to calculate all of the heal prediction and absorb data needed for passing directly into other APIs.
::This object provides various options, such as allowing for damage absorbs to be clamped to either missing health, missing health after adding incoming healing, or maximum health.
::Very brief example shown below:
<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
local calculator = CreateUnitHealPredictionCalculator();
UnitGetDetailedHealPrediction(unit, unitDoingTheHealing, calculator);  -- 'calculator' is updated with new data after this call.
local incomingHeals, incomingHealsFromHealer, incomingHealsFromOthers, incomingHealsClamped = calculator:GetIncomingHeals();
myStatusBar:SetValue(incomingHealsFromHealer);
</syntaxhighlight>
;{{text|blizz|Cast Bars}}
:Added a new optional direction parameter to {{api|StatusBar:SetTimerDuration}} that allows the status bar to calculate its fill from remaining duration rather than elapsed (for channeled spells primarily).
;{{text|blizz|Party Kill Event}}
:Added a new {{api|t=e|PARTY_KILL}} event that gets sent when a party member kills a unit. The payload is 2 [[unitGUID]]s, the attacker and target. Both are secret when the associated unit's identity is secret.
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Currently being worked on</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Whitelisting Select Spells}}
:Adding numerous spells to the whitelists for cooldown/aura secrecy: [[Skyriding]] spells, the [[61304|GCD spell]], Maelstrom Weapon, Devourer DH resource spells, Combat Res spells.
:Continue to call out spells that you think should be whitelisted, we will evaluate each of them individually.
;{{text|blizz|Removing Old Duration APIs}}
:We are removing several APIs (in C_UnitAuras, C_Spell and C_ActionBar) that are no longer needed now that [[ScriptObject DurationObject|Duration objects]] are a thing.
;{{text|blizz|Generic Boolean To Color APIs}}
:We are adding 2 new APIs ({{api|C_CurveUtil.EvaluateColorFromBoolean}} and {{api|C_CurveUtil.EvaluateColorValueFromBoolean}}) that can be used to convert a secret boolean to a color.
::This is in preference to adding SetStatusBarColorFromBoolean, SetColorTextureFromBoolean, etc.
;{{text|blizz|Lots More Cast Bar Stuff}}
:We are adding a new castbar spell sequence ID delivered with spellcast events and from the {{api|UnitCastingInfo}}/{{api|UnitChannelInfo}} APIs. This sequence ID is only delivered for casting events that should display a castbar in the UI, is incremented on each new spellcast, and is never secret.
:We will be removing secret restrictions on several values needed by addons to properly display enemy empowered casts (number of stages and the percentage of cast time each stage consumes).
:We will be adding a way to include the hold-at-max time of empowered casts in a duration object.
;{{text|blizz|Formatting Secret Times}}
:We are adding a new SecondsFormatter Lua object that will allow addons to format secret time values into strings.
:Other numeric formatting solutions are also being worked on, including a solution for formatting differences between cast durations (eg. for spell pushback).
;{{text|blizz|Restricted Environment Issues}}
:Several functions ({{api|strsplit}}, {{api|strjoin}}, {{api|strconcat}}) that got mistakenly removed from the [[RestrictedEnvironment|restricted environment]] are being added back.
;{{text|blizz|Reload UI & Secrets}}
:We are fixing an issue where secret values are made non-secret following a UI reload.
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Coming soon</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Exploit Fixes}}
:We will be fixing a whole host of exploits and addon communication workarounds. Keep those exploit reports coming they are very helpful!
;{{text|blizz|Nameplate HitRect APIs}}
:We will be adding an API to allow addons to override the offsets of nameplate hit-rects and reparent the hit rect to the parent nameplate instead of the child unit frame.
;{{text|blizz|Forced Secret Cvars}}
:We are going to be making some adjustments to the cvars that force secret states so they are more useful for addon devs.
</details>

===December 22: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1452779863374168158 Midnight PTR 2 Changes]===
Blizzard again! Below are the changes that are in PTR 2 that were not in PTR 1. 

Reminder that all of these changes will be in Beta 6 when that goes up in January.

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>New Changes in PTR 2 (ETA 12/22)</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Cast Bar Changes}}
:Added a new field "castBarID" to all spellcast events and the {{api|UnitCastingInfo}}/{{api|UnitChannelInfo}} APIs. CastBarID is only delivered for casting events that should display a castbar in the UI, is incremented on each new spellcast, and is never secret. It can be used to identify and compare casts.
:The isTradeskill, isEmpowered and numEmpowerStages fields are no longer secret in the UnitCastingInfo/UnitChannelInfo APIs.
:Added new API {{api|UnitEmpoweredChannelDuration("unitToken"[, includeHoldAtMaxTime])}} which returns a duration object for an empowered cast, optionally including the hold-at-max time (default: true).
:Added new API {{api|UnitEmpoweredStageDurations("unitToken")}} which returns a vector of duration objects for each stage of an empowered cast, with the final element always being the hold-at-max period.
:Added new API {{api|UnitEmpoweredStagePercentages("unitToken"[, includeHoldAtMaxTime])}} which returns a vector of non-secret percentage values, describing how much of an empowered channel time each stage takes. The last element is the hold-at-max window (unless explicitly requested to be excluded).
;{{text|blizz|Restricted Environment Issues}}
:Several functions ({{api|strsplit}}, {{api|strjoin}}, {{api|strconcat}}) that got mistakenly removed from the restricted environment have been added back in.
;{{text|blizz|Chat Addon QoL Changes}}
:Added new API {{api|C_StringUtil.EscapeLuaFormatString}} that accepts secret strings and replaces all % values with %%.
;{{text|blizz|Misc Changes}}
:{{api|C_UnitAuras.GetAuraApplicationDisplayCount|GetAuraApplicationDisplayCount}} now correctly handles a nil being passed in for maxDisplayCount.
;{{text|blizz|Secret Testing}}
:We have removed all of the existing secretXForced cvars and they have been replaced by cvars that force each restriction type to be enabled ({{apitooltip|type=cvar|name=secretCombatRestrictionsForced|default=0|cat=4|desc=If set, APIs guarded by combat restrictions will return secrets.}}, {{apitooltip|type=cvar|name=secretEncounterRestrictionsForced|default=0|cat=4|desc=If set, APIs guarded by instance encounter restrictions will return secrets.}}, {{apitooltip|type=cvar|name=secretChallengeModeRestrictionsForced|default=0|cat=4|desc=If set, APIs guarded by challenge mode and mythic plus restrictions will return secrets.}}, {{apitooltip|type=cvar|name=secretPvPMatchRestrictionsForced|default=0|cat=4|desc=If set, APIs guarded by PvP match restrictions will return secrets.}}, and {{apitooltip|type=cvar|name=secretMapRestrictionsForced|default=0|cat=4|desc=If set, APIs guarded by map restrictions will return secrets.}}). This should allow addon developers to more easily test their addons by making the client act like it has a restriction type active.
:Added new APIs to test the secrecy of particular spells or power types: {{api|C_Secrets.GetSpellAuraSecrecy|GetSpellAuraSecrecy}}, {{api|C_Secrets.GetSpellCooldownSecrecy|GetSpellCooldownSecrecy}}, {{api|C_Secrets.GetSpellCastSecrecy|GetSpellCastSecrecy}}, and {{api|C_Secrets.GetPowerTypeSecrecy|GetPowerTypeSecrecy}}. These APIs return a non-secret [[Enum.SecrecyLevel|SecrecyLevel enum ]]value indicating if the passed in spell/power type is always secret, never secret or contextually secret.
:Added new API {{api|C_Secrets.ShouldUnitHealthMaxBeSecret|ShouldUnitHealthMaxBeSecret}} which takes a unit token and returns a non-secret Boolean.
</details>

==January 12: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1460387750480969840 Midnight Beta 6 Changes]==
Blizzard again! Below you will find a list of changes we are making to addon restriction APIs in the coming weeks.
These are not the entirety of the changes we are planning, just the ones already committed to for the immediately upcoming Beta releases.

IMPORTANT: The [[patch 12.0.0|12.0.0 build]] currently on the [[PTR]] has been chosen as the official Release Candidate for 12.0.0 (pre-patch). We still have a few high priority changes that we are aiming to sneak into 12.0.0 before pre-patch goes live (listed below), but by and large you can expect things to remain pretty stable on PTR from here until pre-patch.

We are continuing to make changes in [[patch 12.0.1|12.0.1]], and you will see those changes in Beta starting this week. RC for 12.0.1 is also fast approaching however, so we are concentrating on high priority changes there as well (with our main focus being exploits). After we finish up our last few high priority addon-related tasks for 12.0.1 we will be moving onto medium priority tasks and aiming to get as many of them into 12.0.1 as we can.

Thank you so much for all of your feedback in the ⁠addon-restrictions-feedback channel! Our focus for Midnight launch has been on fixing the really critical issues that were blocking a large number of addons from getting operational, but once work on 12.0.1 is complete we will be turning our focus towards the other requests you have made.

We have already entered dozens of medium priority tasks from your requests, and will continue to monitor the channel and make further tasks as they come up. Once we get closer to 12.0.1 launch we will release a list of tasks we plan to work on for [[patch 12.0.5|12.0.5]] so you can have a better idea of the upcoming roadmap.

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Changes likely to make Pre-patch</big>}}</summary>
:We are fixing an issue causing {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetUnitAuraBySpellID|GetUnitAuraBySpellID}} and {{api|C_UnitAuras.GetPlayerAuraBySpellID|GetPlayerAuraBySpellID}} to be Lua error even when passed non-secret spells.
:We are fixing the issues with MoneyFrame in tooltips.
:We are addressing issues with spell pushbacks & delays in cast bar fontstrings.
</details>
<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>The following changes are already on PTR, and will also be in Beta 6</big>}}</summary>
; {{text|blizz|Whitelisting Select Spells}}
: The following spells have been flagged as having non-secret cooldowns:
 61304  - Global Cooldown
 361584 - Whirling Surge
 372608 - Surge Forward
 372610 - Skyward Ascent
 403092 - Aerial Halt
 418592 - Lightning Rush
 425782 - Second Wind
 460002 - Switch Flight Style
 460003 - Switch Flight Style

: The following spells have been flagged as having non-secret aura data:
 344179  - Maelstrom Weapon
 369968  - Skyriding Racing
 377234  - Thrill of the Skies
 388367  - Ohn'ahra's Gusts
 404464 	- Flight Style: Skyriding
 404468  - Flight Style: Steady
 418590  - Static Charge
 1217607 - Void Metamorphosis
 1225789 - Void Metamorphosis (resource aura)
 1227702 - Collapsing Star

;{{text|blizz|Combat Res Cooldowns}}
: All combat res spells now have non-secret cooldowns and charge counts.
;{{text|blizz|Reload UI & Secrets}}
: We have fixed an issue where secret values were made non-secret following a reload ui.
;{{text|blizz|Removing Old Duration APIs}}
: We have removed the following APIs (addons should use the new Duration Object type instead from now on):  C_ActionBar.GetActionCooldownRemaining, C_ActionBar.GetActionCooldownRemainingPercent, C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownRemaining, C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownRemainingPercent, C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDurationRemaining, C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDurationRemainingPercent
;{{text|blizz|Duration Object Utilities}}
: Added 2 new APIs to Duration Objects: EvaluateRemainingDuration(curve, modifier), EvaluateElapsedDuration(curve, modifier)
;{{text|blizz|Generic Boolean To Color APIs}}
: Added 2 new APIs (C_CurveUtil.EvaluateColorFromBoolean and C_CurveUtil.EvaluateColorValueFromBoolean) that can be used to convert a secret boolean to a color.
;{{text|blizz|Cast Bar Changes}}
: Added a new field "castBarID" to all spellcast events and the UnitCastingInfo/UnitChannelInfo APIs. CastBarID is only delivered for casting events that should display a castbar in the UI, is incremented on each new spellcast, and is never secret. It can be used to identify and compare casts.
: The isTradeskill, isEmpowered and numEmpowerStages fields are no longer secret in the UnitCastingInfo/UnitChannelInfo APIs.
: Added new API UnitEmpoweredChannelDuration("unitToken"[, includeHoldAtMaxTime]) which returns a duration object for an empowered cast, optionally including the hold-at-max time (default: true).
: Added new API UnitEmpoweredStageDurations("unitToken") which returns a vector of duration objects for each stage of an empowered cast, with the final element always being the hold-at-max period.
: Added new API UnitEmpoweredStagePercentages("unitToken"[, includeHoldAtMaxTime]) which returns a vector of non-secret percentage values, describing how much of an empowered channel time each stage takes. The last element is the hold-at-max window (unless explicitly requested to be excluded).
;{{text|blizz|Restricted Environment Issues}}
: Several functions (strsplit, strjoin, strconcat) that got mistakenly removed from the restricted environment have been added back in.
;{{text|blizz|Secret Testing}}
: We have removed all of the existing secretXForced cvars and they have been replaced by cvars that force each restriction type to be enabled (secretCombatRestrictionsForced, secretEncounterRestrictionsForced, secretChallengeModeRestrictionsForced, secretPvPMatchRestrictionsForced, and secretMapRestrictionsForced). This should allow addon developers to more easily test their addons by making the client act like it has a restriction type active.
: Added new APIs to test the secrecy of particular spells or power types: GetSpellAuraSecrecy, GetSpellCooldownSecrecy, GetSpellCastSecrecy, and GetPowerTypeSecrecy. These APIs return a non-secret SecrecyLevel enum value indicating if the passed in spell/power type is always secret, never secret or contextually secret.
: Added new API ShouldUnitHealthMaxBeSecret which takes a unit token and returns a non-secret Boolean.
;{{text|blizz|Chat Addon QoL Changes}}
: Added new APIC_StringUtil.EscapeLuaFormatString that accepts secret strings and replaces all % values with %%.
;{{text|blizz|Misc Changes}}
: GetAuraApplicationDisplayCount now correctly handles a nil being passed in for maxDisplayCount.
</details>
<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Coming in Beta 6 (ETA 1/14)</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Exploit Fixes}}
:We have addressed various exploits with the {{api|AbbreviateNumbers}} API. Breakpoints passed to AbbreviateNumbers can now only be powers of 10.
:We have addressed various exploits involving passing creature IDs into [[TString|{{!}}T string markup]]. |T markup is no longer allowed to reference a loose texture file (one not shipped with the client) using secret text.
:We have addressed an exploit with the {{api|C_NamePlate.GetNamePlateForUnit|GetNamePlateForUnit}} API. GetNamePlateForUnit no longer accepts compound unit tokens (e.g. boss1target) from tainted code.
:We have addressed various exploits with CooldownFrameTemplate. It now uses alpha instead of shown state (and has the alpha secret aspect) to show/hide base on the cooldown being active or not.
:We have addressed various exploits with aura instance IDs. Aura Instance IDs are no longer unique across all units (so the same ID can and will be used on different units for totally different auras).
;{{text|blizz|UnitHealPredictionCalculator}}
:We have added several new APIs to {{apitype|UnitHealPredictionCalculator}}: GetCurrentHealth, GetMaximumHealth, GetMissingHealth, GetTotalIncomingHeals, GetTotalIncomingHealsFromHealer, GetTotalDamageAbsorbs, GetTotalHealAbsorbs, GetMaximumIncomingHeals, GetMaximumDamageAbsorbs and GetMaximumHealAbsorbs.
:The new SetMaximumHealthMode API accepts a UnitMaximumHealthMode enum and allows addons to choose whether the max health should include absorbs or not. GetMaximumHealthMode returns the current mode.
:The new ResetPredictedValues API can be used to reset all stored healing values.
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Tooltip Data Line Changes</big>}}</summary>
A future 12.0.1 build will be making the following changes to C_TooltipInfo and data line types.

:All Restricted<X> line types have been replaced by a single new line type (UsageRequirement) with two data arguments:
::requirementType - maps to a new TooltipDataUsageRequirementType enum.
::usable (bool) - false when leftColor is red. In most cases it will never be true as the line just won't show up if it would be white.
::Depending on the requirementType there will be other args. All args in these notes are number type unless otherwise specified.

;Converted requirement types
:RaceClass (RACE_CLASS_ONLY, ITEM_RACES_ALLOWED, or ITEM_CLASSES_ALLOWED)
:Faction (ITEM_REQ_HORDE, ITEM_REQ_ALLIANCE)
:Skill (ITEM_MIN_SKILL, ITEM_REQ_SKILL)
:PvPMedal (ITEM_REQ_SKILL)
::  arg: medal (used for PVP_MEDALx globalstrings)
:Reputation (ITEM_REQ_REPUTATION)
::  args: factionID, reactionLevel
:Level (ITEM_MIN_LEVEL, ITEM_LEVEL_RANGE_CURRENT)
::  args: level, maxLevel (only when it's ITEM_LEVEL_RANGE_CURRENT)
:NotInArena (ARENA_NOT_USABLE) - Was RestrictedArena.
:NotInRatedBg (RATEDBG_NOT_USABLE) - Was RestrictedBg`.
:NotAlreadyKnown (ITEM_SPELL_KNOWN, ERR_COSMETIC_KNOWN) - Was RestrictedSpellKnown.

;New requirement types
:Guild (ITEM_REQ_PURCHASE_GUILD)
:Achievement (ITEM_REQ_PURCHASE_ACHIEVEMENT)
::  arg: achievementID
:PvPRank (ITEM_REQ_SKILL)
::  arg: rank
:EquippedItem (SPELL_EQUIPPED_ITEM_NOSPACE, SPELL_EQUIPPED_ITEM)
:ShapeshiftForm (SPELL_REQUIRED_FORM_NOSPACE, SPELL_REQUIRED_FORM)
:ArenaRating (ITEM_REQ_ARENA_RATING_5V5, ITEM_REQ_ARENA_RATING_3V3_BG, ITEM_REQ_ARENA_RATING_BG)
::  args: bracket, rating
:EarnCurrency (ITEM_REQ_AMOUNT_EARNED)
::  args: currencyID, amount
:Specialization (ITEM_REQ_SPECIALIZATION)
::  arg: specID
 
;Other changes
:ItemName now has quality arg
:QuestObjective now has additional args when it's a goal and not something like "Ready for turn-in": numRequired, numFullfilled, progressBarPercent (optional).

;New Line types
:ItemSpellTriggerLearn with spellID arg (typically recipe items).
:LearnTransmogSet with setID arg.
:LearnTransmogIllusion with spellID arg.
:TradeTimeRemaining with secondsLeft arg.
:ItemQuality - This is the quality name when colorblind mode is enabled, erroneously tagged as ItemName before.
:ErrorLine - Any line with line type None and color FF2020 will go out as this instead (not guaranteed to be an actual error, like bosses killed in InstanceLock tooltip type).
:DisabledLine - Any line with line type None and color 808080 will go out as this instead.
</details>

==January 21: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1463646352239235259 Midnight Beta 7 Changes]==
Blizzard again! Below you will find a list of changes we are making to addon restriction APIs in the coming weeks.
These are not the entirety of the changes we are planning, just the ones already committed to for the immediately upcoming Beta releases.

IMPORTANT: The RC process for 12.0.1 is due to start later this week. As a result, only very high priority issues are being worked on in 12.0.1 (mostly exploits, but also a smattering of remaining high-priority addon dev requests). Once we get closer to 12.0.1 launch we will release a list of tasks we plan to work on for 12.0.5 so you can have a better idea of the upcoming roadmap (including many of your requests).

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Critical changes we will be hotfixing to Pre-patch</big>}}</summary>
*We are addressing various issues with secrets in tooltips.
*We are addressing secret-related lua errors in Edit Mode.
*We are addressing secret-related lua errors with dropdowns.
</details>
<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Changes in Beta 7</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Exploit Fixes}}
*We have addressed further exploits with aura instance IDs.
**Added a new Lua type called UnitTokenRestrictedForAddOns which is used in several aura and nameplate APIs and doesn't accept compound unit tokens (boss1target) or player/pet names from addons.
**The "targettarget" token is exempt from this restriction.
*We have addressed a whole host of addon communication workarounds:
**QuestLogPushQuest is now restricted while in combat.
***PingLocation is no longer accessible to addons.
***MINIMAP_PING is now a secure callback event with secret payloads.
***UnitIsAFK and UnitIsDND now return secrets when chat message lockdown is active.
***The PLAYER_FLAGS_CHANGED event no longer gets sent when AFK or DND are changed and chat message lockdown is active.
***BNSetAFK and BNSetDND can no longer be called by addons when chat message lockdown is active.
***The following events now have secret payloads when chat messaging lockdown is active: START_PLAYER_COUNTDOWN, CANCEL_PLAYER_COUNTDOWN, READY_CHECK, GUILD_MOTD
***The following C_LFGList APIs return secrets when chat messaging lockdown is active: GetApplicantInfo, GetActiveEntryInfo, GetSearchResultInfo, GetSearchResultPlayerInfo, GetSearchResultLeaderInfo
***Club memberNote/officerNote values are now secret while in chat messaging lockdown.
***C_VoiceChat.GetChannel APIs now return a secret list of voice chat channel members while in chat messaging lockdown.
***Calendar Event information now secret while in chat messaging lockdown.
;{{text|blizz|Addon throttles}}
:Fixed an issue where addon throttles were incorrectly throttling addon load time in some cases. (Already hotfixed to pre-patch)
;{{text|blizz|Misc Changes}}
*Added a new SecureAuraButtonTemplate template in SecureGroupHeader.xml.
*Fixed an issue where the C_UnitAuras.AddPrivateAuraAppliedSound API caused lua errors at the time of the sound playing. (Will be hotfixed to pre-patch)
*Fixed an issue where the GetUnitAuraBySpellID and GetPlayerAuraBySpellID APIs would lua error even when passed non-secret spells. (Already hotfixed to pre-patch)
</details>

==January 27: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1465776507237568664 Midnight Beta 8 Changes]==
Blizzard again! Below you will find a list of changes we are making to addon restriction APIs in the coming weeks.

These are not the entirety of the changes we are planning, just the ones already committed to for the immediately upcoming Beta releases.

IMPORTANT: The RC process for 12.0.1 has begun, and while the Beta build this week is likely not going to be the final RC we are getting close. As a result, only very high priority issues are being worked on in 12.0.1 (mostly exploits, but also a smattering of remaining high-priority addon dev requests). Once we get closer to 12.0.1 launch we will release a list of tasks we plan to work on for 12.0.5 so you can have a better idea of the upcoming roadmap (including many of your requests).

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Critical changes due to be deployed to live/pre-patch over the next few days</big>}}</summary>
*Fixed an issue where the C_UnitAuras.AddPrivateAuraAppliedSound API caused Lua errors at the time of the sound playing.
*Fixed an issue causing secret-related Lua errors in Edit Mode.
*Fixed an issue causing click casting to get eaten by private auras on raid frames.
*Fixed various issues with secrets in tooltips causing Lua errors.
*Fixed an issue where responding to a BNet whisper could cause a Lua error in auto complete code.
*Fixed an issue causing secret-related Lua errors when addons created dropdowns.
*Fixed an issue where arena frames could cause Lua errors when exiting edit mode.
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Changes in Beta 8 (ETA 1/28)</big>}}</summary>
;{{text|blizz|Boss Warning APIs}}
*Added a new C_EncounterEvents namespace that allows querying static information about encounter events.
*Added a new C_EncounterEvents.SetEventColor API that allows addons to associate a specific color with an encounter event (our UI will use it to colorize text and timer bars).
*Added a new C_EncounterEvents.SetEventSound API that allows addons to specify a sound to play when encounter events show text warnings or transition states on the timeline.
**Sounds will be played automatically by the client.
;{{text|blizz|Aura Filters}}
*Added 4 new filter types for Aura APIs:
**CROWD_CONTROL
**BIG_DEFENSIVE
**RAID_PLAYER_DISPELLABLE (returns auras the player can dispel)
**RAID_IN_COMBAT (returns auras that are flagged to show on raid frames in combat, when used with Player and Helpful filters this should return mostly just HoTs).
;{{text|blizz|Misc Changes}}
*|T string markup inside secret strings now permits the use of local file overrides if the texture is part of the base game.
**Referencing custom addon textures using secret strings is still not allowed.
*Fixed an issue where tainted calls to CVarCallbackRegistry:GetCVarValue could store tainted values in the cached value table, causing restriction issues.
*Fixed an issue in the Restricted Environment ipairs function that caused it to return early when any falsey value was stored in the table.
*Added the optional start and end range parameters to unpack in the Restricted Environment.
</details>

<details>
<summary>{{text|#ecbc2a|<big>Bonus Changes!!!</big>}}</summary>
*Added a new CVar encounterTimelineShowSequenceCount (off by default) which will append a counter onto the end of the name of encounter events that increments after each occurrence of that event.
*Added the following APIs to UnitHealPredictionCalculator: GetCurrentHealthPercent, GetMissingHealthPercent, EvaluateCurrentHealthPercent, EvaluateMissingHealthPercent.
*Player data returned by PvP scoreboard APIs is now secret during an active PvP match.
*Fixed an issue where addons using PingableUnitFrameTemplate would result in Lua errors when the player pinged on them.
*Adjusted some script object APIs to no longer return secrets: HasScript, CanChangeAttribute, CanChangeProtectedState, IsAnchoringSecret, IsAnchoringRestricted, IsPreventingSecretValues, GetSourceLocation, GetNumMaskTextures/GetMaskTexture.
</details>

==February 3: [https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1468459745785417769 Midnight Beta IX Changes Tetra Master Edition]==
Hello again from Blizzard again!

DISCLAIMER: These notes are for addon authors and as such are focused specifically on addon security changes only. Changes planned for other parts of the game (UI or otherwise) are not included here.

IMPORTANT: We have picked our final RC for 12.0.1 pre-patch day and as such the Beta this week (Beta 9) will be the final Beta build for 12.0.1. With 3 weeks left until Midnight launch there are still a handful of fixes that we plan to hotfix before launch day, but you can expect those changes to be only very high priority things (bugfixes, exploit fixes, etc) rather than major API changes.

With the Midnight Beta process drawing to a close, you can also expect these updates from us to slow down in pace a little. That doesn't mean we are going to go silent by any means (we will be releasing a roadmap of planned 12.0.5 changes around launch day and posting important updates as they come up) but expect these API change updates to slow down to maybe once a month or so.

NOTE: Beta 9 doesn't have any addon-related changes in it that Beta 8 didn't, so the notes below will focus on critical changes that we are aiming to hotfix in to 12.0.1.

On a more personal note, I want to take a moment to thank all of you for your patience and excellent feedback throughout this whole process. I know this has not been an easy process for many of you and that making the necessary updates to your addons was not easy (and was in some cases impossible). Despite all of that, you have provided us with absolutely VITAL feedback throughout alpha and beta.

You pointed us towards numerous bugs and exploits and helped us prioritize the changes that were most vital for addon developers. We would not have gotten to this point without your help, and I want to truly thank ALL of you. Keep that feedback coming and stay tuned for a preview of our planned improvements for post-launch soon!

<details open>
{{apisummary.header|Critical changes due to be deployed to before 12.0.1 Patch day}}
*Fixed an exploit with secret numbers and loops (shhh you didn't read this, it never happened).
*Fixed an exploit with secret info leaking about whether a cast was interruptible.
*Fixed various addon communication workarounds in Club APIs.
*Fixed another exploit that allowed aurainstanceIDs to be "unsecreted".
*Added a new IMPORTANT filter type for Aura APIs
</details>
<details open>
{{apisummary.header|Critical changes we are plan to deploy before Midnight launch}}
*We are fixing an issue where status bars can leak secrets.
*We are fixing an issue where cooldown objects were not applying the cooldown aspect correctly.
*We are fixing an issue where addons appending lines to certain tooltips would cause lua errors.
*We are fixing an issue with cast delays in addon cast bars.
</details>

: ➡️ Follow-up: [[Patch 12.0.1/API changes#Blue posts]]
